objective.name: sandbox.dsl.chain.depth
objective.description: Sequential DSL chain of fixed depth used to measure per-hop latency cost in N8 stress tests.

#root.role: Execute 5 sequential wrapper calls and return the accumulated hop count.

effects.local_wrapper_runtime: The local wrapper runtime is invoked 5 times sequentially.

transformation_contract.morphing: Each DSL step invokes the local wrapper echo once, producing a chain of 5 sequential round-trips through the execution family.
invariants: The chain always executes exactly 5 steps regardless of input.
Each step passes the previous echo result as input to the next.
The final response carries hops=5 and the last echoed message.
success: On success, returns hops=5 and last_echo equal to the input message echoed through the final step.
failure: Fails terminally if any wrapper step fails.
notes: Used exclusively by N8_STRESS_02 to measure DSL sequential chain latency scaling.
